notes.title: Outsider 0.3.3 Released
notes.content:
This build has some bug fixes and new features!

- Bringing up the game menu while switching chapters no longer corrupts the screen
- Exiting a boss screen called from the exclamation mark with the Esc key no longer shows a buggy menu
- Tutorial can be skipped from the game menu
- Removed text highlighting before decisions. It was ugly and wasn't helping players.
- Added support for extending playtest build past the Demo (will be visible to playtesters soon)
- All font weights have been tweaked
- Mono 1 font is now Chivo Mono due to better font weight support
- Decisions can be chosen with arrow keys
- Minor text tweaks including nontrivial tutorial improvements
- Major compatibility fixes for loading old saved games after chapter updates. This will improve ongoing compatibility for playtesters (and actual retail players in the future) while allowing changes to chapters.

notes.title: Outsider 0.3.2 Released
notes.content:
This is a release candidate build for the external Outsider demo. The full change list compared to the previous playtest is huge, but these are the highlights:

- Tutorial + Chapters 1-4
- Font selection + tweaks on font clarity everywhere
- Emoji reference
- Audio remastering + sound leveling
- More soundtrack songs
- Full controller, keyboard and mouse support: you just need one of the three to fully play the game.
- New scrolling engine: text scrolling should be smoother everywhere with acceleration support whenever driver offers it
- Tons of art improvements
- Mysterious second screen and animations
